## Executive Summary

```{r executive-summary}
if (!is.null(model)) {
  # Extract key results
  estimates <- extract_estimates(model)
  treatment_effect <- estimates[grepl("treatment", rownames(estimates)), ]
  
  if (nrow(treatment_effect) > 0) {
    te_est <- treatment_effect$Estimate[1]
    te_lower <- treatment_effect$Q2.5[1]
    te_upper <- treatment_effect$Q97.5[1]
    te_prob_positive <- mean(extract_posterior(model, "b_treatment") > 0)
    
    cat("**Key Findings:**\n\n")
    cat("- **Treatment Effect Estimate:**", round(te_est, 3), "\n")
    cat("- **95% Credible Interval:** [", round(te_lower, 3), ",", round(te_upper, 3), "]\n")
    cat("- **Probability of Positive Effect:**", round(te_prob_positive * 100, 1), "%\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("*No model provided for analysis.*")
}
```

## Model Specification

```{r model-specification}
if (!is.null(model) && !is.null(model$model_spec)) {
  spec <- model$model_spec
  
  cat("**Model Details:**\n\n")
  cat("- **Model Name:**", ifelse(is.null(spec$model_name), "Unnamed", spec$model_name), "\n")
  cat("- **Outcome Variable:**", spec$outcome, "\n") 
  cat("- **Predictors:**", spec$predictors, "\n")
  cat("- **Family:**", spec$family, "\n")
  cat("- **Link Function:**", spec$link, "\n")
  
  # Show prior specifications if available
  if (!is.null(model$prior_spec)) {
    cat("\n**Prior Specifications:**\n\n")
    print(kable(model$prior_spec$priors, caption = "Prior Specifications"))
  }
} else {
  cat("*Model specification not available.*")
}
```

## Model Results

### Parameter Estimates

```{r parameter-estimates}

  kable(estimates, 
        digits = 3,
        caption = "Posterior Parameter Estimates",
        col.names = c("Estimate", "Std Error", "2.5%", "97.5%", "Rhat", "Bulk ESS", "Tail ESS"))
} else {
  cat("*No model results available.*")
}
```

### Treatment Effect Focus

```{r treatment-effect}
if (!is.null(model)) {
  # Focus on treatment parameters
  estimates <- extract_estimates(model)
  treatment_params <- estimates[grepl("treatment", rownames(estimates), ignore.case = TRUE), ]
  
  if (nrow(treatment_params) > 0) {
    kable(treatment_params,
          digits = 3, 
          caption = "Treatment Effect Estimates")
  } else {
    cat("*No treatment effects found in model.*")
  }
} else {
```

## Model Diagnostics

### Convergence Assessment

```{r convergence}
if (!is.null(model)) {
  diagnostics <- check_diagnostics(model)
  
  cat("**Convergence Summary:**\n\n")
  
  if (!is.null(diagnostics$rhat_issues)) {
    if (diagnostics$rhat_issues > 0) {
      cat("⚠️ **Warning:**", diagnostics$rhat_issues, "parameters have Rhat > 1.01\n")
    } else {
      cat("✅ **Good:** All parameters have Rhat ≤ 1.01\n")  
    }
  }
  
  if (!is.null(diagnostics$ess_issues)) {
    if (diagnostics$ess_issues > 0) {
      cat("⚠️ **Warning:**", diagnostics$ess_issues, "parameters have low effective sample size\n")
    } else {
      cat("✅ **Good:** All parameters have adequate effective sample size\n")
    }
  }
  
  if (!is.null(diagnostics$divergences)) {
    if (diagnostics$divergences > 0) {
      cat("⚠️ **Warning:**", diagnostics$divergences, "divergent transitions detected\n")
    } else {
      cat("✅ **Good:** No divergent transitions\n")
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("*No model available for diagnostic assessment.*")
}
```

## Conclusions

```{r conclusions}
if (!is.null(model)) {
  # Extract treatment effect for conclusions
  estimates <- extract_estimates(model)
  treatment_effect <- estimates[grepl("treatment", rownames(estimates)), ]
  
  if (nrow(treatment_effect) > 0) {
    te_est <- treatment_effect$Estimate[1]
    te_lower <- treatment_effect$Q2.5[1] 
    te_upper <- treatment_effect$Q97.5[1]
    
    cat("**Key Conclusions:**\n\n")
    
    # Determine clinical significance (this would be customized for specific contexts)
    if (te_lower > 0) {
      cat("- The treatment shows a **positive effect** with high certainty (95% CI excludes zero)\n")
    } else if (te_upper < 0) {
      cat("- The treatment shows a **negative effect** with high certainty (95% CI excludes zero)\n") 
    } else {
      cat("- The treatment effect is **uncertain** (95% CI includes zero)\n")
    }
    
    cat("- The estimated treatment effect is", round(te_est, 3), "units (95% CI:", round(te_lower, 3), "to", round(te_upper, 3), ")\n")
  }
  
  # Model quality
  diagnostics <- check_diagnostics(model)
  if (is.null(diagnostics$rhat_issues) || diagnostics$rhat_issues == 0) {
    cat("- **Model Quality:** Good convergence achieved\n")
  } else {
    cat("- **Model Quality:** ⚠️ Convergence issues detected - interpret with caution\n")
  }
  
} else {
  cat("*No conclusions available without fitted model.*")
}
```
